base.$description: Placeholder fill. Decorative: hidden from assistive tech and never the only carrier of meaning, so the 3:1 UI-component floor (WCAG 1.4.11) does not apply; forced colors draws a CanvasText border instead.

highlight.$description: Shimmer sweep highlight on top of the base fill.

height.$description: One text line placeholder (14px), close to the x-height band of body copy.

last-width.$description: Width of the last text line when there is more than one.

height.$description: Default height of a free block placeholder (64px); override with --sj-skeleton-height.
